question: In Linear: Rename the '3D Secure Fallback Plan' document in the Payments team whose content covers adding 3D Secure fallback to '3D Secure Fallback Plan — Final'. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
No such document to rename. There is a "3D Secure Fallback Plan" doc in the Payments team, but its content actually covers **token refresh rotation for mobile sessions** (expiry windows and retry limits) — not adding 3D Secure fallback. The only other doc, "Mobile Release Notes," belongs to Payouts.

Since the one matching your title doesn't match your content condition, I left it untouched. If that token-refresh doc was meant to be the 3D Secure plan (maybe the content is stale), let me know and I'll rename it.
